evidence.detail:
Nick chose low instead of lower-medium after comparing technologies. Similar paired ingredients prove neither equal dose nor identical efficacy to OGX.

Model chemistry / a partially inspected supplier poster support plausibility. A comparison against shampoo without conditioner does not isolate specific reinforcement from general conditioning.

JUUT reports styling / care experiences, including after two weeks. Aveda affiliation and sensory endpoints remain explicit; no measured structural repair is inferred.

Targeted pre-shampoo reinforcement; no intensity ranking.

Historical v0.3 evidence observations (owner grades and selected Redken source now follow the later owner decision):

R04's three-times-stronger footnote compares curly hair against shampoo without conditioner; conditioning/deposition contributions are not isolated.

E02 studies crystals, salts and aggregation and explicitly leaves the complete hair-strengthening mechanism unknown. That is a limitation of mechanistic certainty, not proof of no practical effect.

E06 exposes testing methods but not inspected numerical graphs/results; a description of a fatigue assay does not establish its positive result.

E02 is abstract/introduction-level with an Ashland coauthor; E06 is supplier-owned partial indexed text. Amended follow-up did not expose its graphs/results.

R04 supplies the 150 ml DE source version and dry 5–10-minute rinse-off use, not a verified supplied pack.

Bounded required-creator searches supply no readable exact-product efficacy take. Absence is neutral; missing complete supplier outcome evidence remains the concrete trust gap.

No empirical null finding is claimed. Low record confidence concerns trust, while source-version identity and category confidence remain high.

explanations_de.concise: Nick hat nach dem Technologievergleich Low statt unterem Medium gewählt. Die ähnliche Wirkstoffkombination beweist weder gleiche Dosierung noch identische Wirksamkeit mit OGX.
explanations_de.deeper:
Modellchemie / unvollständig geprüftes Lieferantenposter stützen Plausibilität. Der Vergleich mit Shampoo ohne Conditioner trennt allgemeine Pflege nicht von spezifischer Stärkung.

JUUT berichtet Styling-/Pflegeerfahrungen, auch nach zwei Wochen. Aveda-Verbindung und sensorische Endpunkte bleiben sichtbar; keine gemessene Strukturreparatur daraus ableiten.

Nicht final bewertet; gemeinsame Technologie ist keine Gewichtsaussage.

Model chemistry / a partially inspected supplier poster support plausibility. A comparison against shampoo without conditioner does not isolate specific reinforcement from general conditioning.

JUUT reports styling / care experiences, including after two weeks. Aveda affiliation and sensory endpoints remain explicit; no measured structural repair is inferred.

Targeted pre-shampoo reinforcement; no intensity ranking.

Historical v0.3 evidence observations (owner grades and selected Redken source now follow the later owner decision):

R04's three-times-stronger footnote compares curly hair against shampoo without conditioner; conditioning/deposition contributions are not isolated.

E02 studies crystals, salts and aggregation and explicitly leaves the complete hair-strengthening mechanism unknown. That is a limitation of mechanistic certainty, not proof of no practical effect.

E06 exposes testing methods but not inspected numerical graphs/results; a description of a fatigue assay does not establish its positive result.

E02 is abstract/introduction-level with an Ashland coauthor; E06 is supplier-owned partial indexed text. Amended follow-up did not expose its graphs/results.

R04 supplies the 150 ml DE source version and dry 5–10-minute rinse-off use, not a verified supplied pack.

Bounded required-creator searches supply no readable exact-product efficacy take. Absence is neutral; missing complete supplier outcome evidence remains the concrete trust gap.

No empirical null finding is claimed. Low record confidence concerns trust, while source-version identity and category confidence remain high.

explanations_de.concise: Nick hat nach dem Technologievergleich Low statt unterem Medium gewählt. Die ähnliche Wirkstoffkombination beweist weder gleiche Dosierung noch identische Wirksamkeit mit OGX.
explanations_de.deeper:
Modellchemie / unvollständig geprüftes Lieferantenposter stützen Plausibilität. Der Vergleich mit Shampoo ohne Conditioner trennt allgemeine Pflege nicht von spezifischer Stärkung.

JUUT berichtet Styling-/Pflegeerfahrungen, auch nach zwei Wochen. Aveda-Verbindung und sensorische Endpunkte bleiben sichtbar; keine gemessene Strukturreparatur daraus ableiten.

Nicht final bewertet; gemeinsame Technologie ist keine Gewichtsaussage.
